# infisical_pam_account_user (Resource)

Manage a user's membership in a PAM account, which grants its role on the account. The user must already be a PAM member. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_pam_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
  role  = "member"
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_user" "alice_pamadmin" {
  account_id = "<account-id>"
  email      = infisical_pam_user.alice.email # also makes Terraform add the user to PAM first
  role       = "connector"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The ID of the PAM account. Changing it creates a new membership.
- `email` (String) The email of the user. Changing it creates a new membership.
- `role` (String) The role on the account: `admin`, `operator` (sessions and credentials), `connector` (sessions only) or `auditor` (audit logs and recordings).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the membership.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the user's account membership by account ID and email
terraform import infisical_pam_account_user.example <account_id>:<email>
```
